name: Closing Bell
tagline: Most tokenized stock trades when nobody can price it
description: Warns tokenized-stock liquidity providers when their position is about to sit through hours nobody can price, and hands them a one-click exit they sign themselves.
accentRationale: Two accents, semantic rather than decorative, because the split IS the product argument. #3ddc97 OPEN is an hour in which the underlying has a live price; #f2b455 SHUT is an hour in which it does not and the issuer will not create or redeem. A surface is tinted only when it belongs to one of those two states. The page is amber far more often than green, which is the finding.
fontRationale: No web fonts and no network fetch at paint. Trading-terminal register: system sans for prose, true monospace with tabular figures for every value compared side by side, because the whole page is a comparison of numbers.
shadowRationale: Depth is one-pixel borders and surface-elevation steps only. Glow reads as marketing; this surface has to read as an instrument a liquidity provider would trust with a position.
signatureElement: The week bar: 168 cells, one per hour, 32.5 lit in open and 135.5 unlit in shut. It states the entire thesis without a sentence, and the current hour is marked on it.

motion.reducedMotion: all animation and transition collapsed to 0.01ms

rejectionList: bounce or spring on functional controls
marketing copy in the product surface
any number not read back from a real measurement or a live feed
craftSource: Adopted from ../aval/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md — elevation ladder, zero-shadow rule, five type steps, two radii, colour-only motion, 44px controls. Brand identity is Closing Bell's own.
